title: Goldman adds 4 new names to its favorite stocks list — including a 143% upside defense call
summary: Goldman Sachs has added four new names to its monthly European Conviction List of stock picks, including a defense stock with identified 143% upside potential. The additions signal analyst confidence in specific European equities. This reflects Goldman's view of attractive opportunities in European markets.
content: Goldman Sachs has added four new names to its monthly "European Conviction List" stock picks list.

zh.title: 高盛将4家新公司加入精选股票清单——其中包括一只防守性股票目标涨幅143%
zh.summary: 高盛将四家新名字加入其月度欧洲精选投资清单，包括一只识别出143%上升潜力的防守性股票。这些新增名字表明分析师对特定欧洲股票的信心。这反映了高盛对欧洲市场具有吸引力机会的看法。

title: Sky-high fuel prices push costs up on customers and charities
summary: Rising fuel costs are driving up operational expenses for charities and businesses across the board. The inflationary pressure on fuel disproportionately strains nonprofits, reducing resources available for their missions. This cost squeeze threatens financial stability for vulnerable organizations.
content: Growing fuel costs are leading to an increase in costs for charities and other businesses.

zh.title: 高油价推高客户和慈善机构的成本
zh.summary: 不断上升的燃料成本正在推高整个慈善机构和企业的运营费用。燃料的通胀压力对非营利组织造成不成比例的压力，减少了用于其使命的资源。这种成本压力威胁到脆弱组织的财务稳定性。

title: I’m in my 20s and keep getting laid off. Should I invest in my employer’s 401(k) or look into other options?
summary: A young worker facing repeated layoffs questions whether to participate in traditional employer 401(k) plans given job market instability. The inquiry reflects broader skepticism about decades-long corporate careers and explores alternative retirement strategies. The piece highlights how generational labor patterns are shifting retirement planning decisions.
content: “I have lost faith that the traditional career spanning decades at one company even exists anymore.”

zh.title: 我20多岁且频繁被裁员。我应该投资雇主的401(k)还是探索其他选择?
zh.summary: 一位面临反复裁员的年轻工作者质疑在劳动力市场不稳定的情况下是否应该参与传统雇主401(k)计划。这个问题反映了对数十年企业职业生涯的更广泛怀疑，并探索了替代退休策略。这篇文章突出了代际劳动模式如何改变退休规划决策。

title: Trump wants South Korea in on Alaska LNG. Here’s why Seoul is cautious
summary: The Trump administration is seeking South Korean participation in Alaska's liquefied natural gas projects as part of broader energy partnerships. South Korea remains cautious due to concerns about high project costs and commercial viability. The negotiations underscore geopolitical dimensions of energy infrastructure in the Asia-Pacific region.
content: South Korea remains cautious on Alaska LNG amid concerns over its high costs and commercial risks.

zh.title: 特朗普希望韩国参与阿拉斯加液化天然气项目。首尔为何持谨慎态度
zh.summary: 特朗普政府正寻求韩国参与阿拉斯加液化天然气项目，作为更广泛能源合作伙伴关系的一部分。韩国因对项目成本高和商业可行性的担忧而保持谨慎态度。这些谈判突显了亚太地区能源基础设施的地缘政治维度。

title: Nike falls to 13-year low. Why analysts don't think the selling is over yet
summary: Nike stock has declined to $31 per share, its lowest price in 13 years, reflecting investor concerns about the company's trajectory. Despite the sharp pullback, analysts warn that further declines are likely. The pessimism suggests structural headwinds beyond typical market cycles.
content: Nike is set to open at $31 per share on Friday, or its lowest price since 2013. However, analysts say it's still not a good time to buy the stock.

zh.title: 耐克股价跌至13年低点。分析师认为下跌可能还未结束
zh.summary: 耐克股价跌至每股31美元，为13年来的最低价格，反映了投资者对公司发展轨迹的担忧。尽管股价急剧回落，分析师警告进一步下跌的可能性很大。这种悲观情绪表明存在超出典型市场周期范围的结构性阻力。

title: Big Pharma turns to China for new drugs as patent cliff drives multibillion-dollar deals
summary: Major Western pharmaceutical companies are increasingly partnering with Chinese firms to develop new drugs as they face the patent cliff of expiring blockbuster patents. These multibillion-dollar deals represent a strategic shift in where Big Pharma sources innovation. The trend reflects how regulatory timelines and patent economics are reshaping the global drug development landscape.
content: Western biopharma companies are increasingly turning to China to source innovation, as pharma's dreaded "patent cliff" draws closer.

zh.title: 大制药公司转向中国开发新药，应对专利悬崖推动数十亿美元交易
zh.summary: 随着大制药公司面临畅销药专利过期的专利悬崖，它们越来越多地与中国公司合作开发新药。这些数十亿美元的交易代表了大制药公司创新来源的战略转变。这一趋势反映了监管时间表和专利经济学如何重塑全球药物开发格局。

title: UK diesel price hits £2 a litre as US calls for Europe to release more stocks
summary: UK diesel prices have reached £2 per litre as fuel costs continue climbing, pressuring motorists and businesses across the country. The U.S. is calling on European nations to release strategic oil reserves to ease pricing pressure. The RAC warns the trend shows no signs of reversing, heaping financial hardship on drivers.
content: The RAC says diesel price rises are showing no signs of slowing, "heaping more misery" onto drivers.

zh.title: 英国柴油价格升至每升2英镑，美国呼吁欧洲释放更多库存
zh.summary: 英国柴油价格已达到每升2英镑，燃料成本继续攀升，对全国各地的驾车者和企业造成压力。美国呼吁欧洲国家释放战略石油储备以缓解价格压力。RAC警告称这一趋势没有逆转的迹象，给驾驶者带来沉重的经济负担。

title: Burger King is betting on local franchisees to fuel its U.S. comeback
summary: Burger King is refranchising hundreds of company-owned restaurants to local operators as part of its U.S. turnaround strategy. The shift prioritizes local franchisees over corporate control, aiming to improve operational efficiency and market competitiveness. This represents a significant pivot in Burger King's business model.
content: Burger King is refranchising hundreds of its company-owned restaurants as part of its turnaround, while prioritizing local operators.

zh.title: 汉堡王押注本地特许经营者推动美国市场回归
zh.summary: 汉堡王正在将数百家公司自有餐厅重新特许经营给本地运营商，作为美国市场复兴战略的一部分。这一转变优先考虑本地特许经营者而非公司控制，旨在改善运营效率和市场竞争力。这代表汉堡王商业模式的重大转变。

title: Google has been playing catch up with OpenAI and Anthropic. Does its new flagship model really compete at the frontier?
summary: Google's new Gemini 4 flagship model marks the company's effort to close a competitive gap with OpenAI and Anthropic that widened throughout 2026. Analysts say the model represents a meaningful step forward in bringing Google back into the frontier AI conversation. The launch underscores intensifying competition in large language model development.
content: Google has been trailing OpenAI and Anthropic for much of 2026, analysts say Gemini 4 puts it back in the frontier AI conversation.

zh.title: 谷歌一直在追赶OpenAI和Anthropic。它的新旗舰模型真的能在最前沿竞争吗？
zh.summary: 谷歌新推出的Gemini 4旗舰模型标志着该公司努力缩小与OpenAI和Anthropic之间的竞争差距，这一差距在2026年全年不断扩大。分析师表示该模型代表了一个有意义的进步，使谷歌重新进入最前沿人工智能的对话中。该发布凸显了大语言模型开发中日趋激烈的竞争。

title: TV dinner overload? The frozen-food aisle may be too crowded for its own good.
summary: Conagra Brands' extensive frozen-food portfolio has become so large that its products increasingly compete against each other rather than external competitors. Industry analysts warn the frozen-food aisle is overcrowded, leading to internal cannibalization and reduced efficiency. The issue highlights potential portfolio management missteps at major food companies.
content: Industry giant Conagra Brands has so many frozen-food items that they’re competing against each other, an analyst says.

zh.title: 电视晚餐过剩？冷冻食品区可能过于拥挤
zh.summary: 康尼格拉品牌的广泛冷冻食品组合变得非常庞大，其产品越来越多地相互竞争，而不是与外部竞争对手竞争。行业分析师警告冷冻食品区过度拥挤，导致内部相互蚕食和效率下降。该问题凸显了大型食品公司潜在的投资组合管理失误。

title: Three reasons this Wall Street market-making powerhouse says investors should reload on stocks right now
summary: Citadel Securities' Scott Rubner identifies three reasons why investors should increase stock exposure following September's market decline. The market-making powerhouse views the sell-off as a healthy reset rather than a warning sign. Analysts suggest this positioning could support equity gains into year-end.
content: September provided a stock-market reset, pointing to a good end to the year, says Scott Rubner of Citadel Securities.

zh.title: 华尔街做市巨头给出三个理由说投资者现在应该增加股票投资
zh.summary: 城堡证券公司的斯科特·鲁布纳指出了投资者在九月市场下跌后应该增加股票敞口的三个理由。这家做市巨头将抛售视为健康的重置，而不是警告信号。分析师认为这一定位可能支持股票在年底前的涨幅。

title: The secret signs the bond sell-off might be ending
summary: Market analysis suggests a significant bond sell-off that has persisted for months may be reaching its conclusion based on options activity in the utility sector. A large options bet could signal that yields are approaching a peak. This potential inflection point carries implications for fixed-income strategies and broader market dynamics.
content: A big options bet involving the utility sector could indicate a top in yields.

zh.title: 债券抛售可能即将结束的秘密信号
zh.summary: 市场分析表明，基于公用事业部门的期权活动，持续数月的债券大幅抛售可能即将结束。一笔大额期权交易可能表明收益率正接近峰值。这个潜在的拐点对固定收益策略和更广泛的市场动态有重要影响。

title: Here’s the bond-market alternative as U.S. and other developed markets debt deteriorate
summary: Jefferies analyst Christopher Wood argues that developed-market government bonds have been in a structural bear market since March 2020 as debt fundamentals deteriorate. He examines alternative fixed-income opportunities for investors facing headwinds in traditional government debt. The analysis highlights long-term structural challenges in developed-market bond markets.
content: Jefferies’s Christopher Wood says bonds of the Group of Seven have been in a “structural bear market” since March 2020.

zh.title: 美国和其他发达市场债务恶化之际的债券市场替代品选择
zh.summary: Jefferies分析师Christopher Wood认为，自2020年3月以来，发达市场政府债券一直处于结构性熊市，债务基本面恶化。他研究了面临传统政府债务挑战的投资者的替代固定收益机会。该分析凸显了发达市场债券市场面临的长期结构性挑战。

title: Brazil is holding an election — and for the stock market, there’s more to gain than to lose, says fund manager
summary: An emerging-market fund manager sees stock market opportunity in Brazil's upcoming election, particularly if results deviate from current polling expectations. A polling surprise could trigger a sharp rally in emerging-market equities. The analysis highlights how electoral outcomes in major emerging markets can create significant investment opportunities.
content: Were Flavio Bolsonaro to outperform current polling Sunday, an emerging-market fund manager see the opportunity for a sharp rally in stocks

zh.title: 巴西即将举行大选——基金经理表示股市收益大于风险
zh.summary: 一位新兴市场基金经理看好巴西即将举行的大选对股市的机会，尤其是如果选举结果偏离当前民调预期。民调意外可能会触发新兴市场股票的急剧上涨。该分析强调了主要新兴市场的选举结果如何能创造重要的投资机会。

title: Nike shares plummet 10% after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway
summary: Nike's stock fell 10% in premarket trading following weak revenue guidance and announced workforce reductions. The decline continues a second consecutive day of losses for the athletic apparel maker. The weak outlook and cost-cutting measures signal mounting structural challenges for Nike.
content: Nike's shares plummeted in premarket trading, continuing a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

zh.title: 耐克股价在弱收入前景和裁员计划公布后下跌10%
zh.summary: 耐克股票在弱收入指导和宣布员工减少后，盘前交易中下跌10%。这是这家运动服装制造商连续第二天下跌。弱前景和成本削减措施表明耐克面临日益增加的结构性挑战。

title: U.S. trade representative Greer says deal with India not 'imminent' after Modi-Trump call
summary: U.S. trade representative Greer said a trade deal with India is not imminent following talks between Modi and Trump. U.S.-India relations have been strained for over a year, with India facing potential 100% tariffs if it continues buying Russian oil, making this a significant geopolitical pressure point.
content: Ties between the U.S. and India have been under strain for over a year, and New Delhi faces fresh risk of up to 100% tariffs for continuing to buy Russian oil.

zh.title: 美国贸易代表格里尔表示与印度交易在莫迪-特朗普通话后并非"迫在眉睫"
zh.summary: 美国贸易代表格里尔表示，在莫迪和特朗普的会谈后，与印度的贸易协议并非迫在眉睫。美国-印度关系已经紧张一年多，印度面临着如果继续购买俄罗斯石油可能被征收100%关税的风险，这构成了一个重要的地缘政治压力点。

title: Move to stop charges for parents to sit by children on flights
summary: The UK government is moving to eliminate fees that allow parents to sit with children on flights, which currently cost up to £104 per return journey. The change addresses a consumer fairness issue affecting families traveling together.
content: The government says sitting together can currently cost a parent and child up to £104 on a return journey.

zh.title: 英国政府采取措施停止向父母收费以便在飞行中与孩子坐在一起
zh.summary: 英国政府正在采取措施消除允许父母在飞行中与孩子坐在一起的费用，目前往返旅程最多需支付104英镑。这一变化解决了影响一起旅行家庭的消费者公平问题。

title: U.S. market regulator seeks to make it easier for funds, advisers to hold crypto
summary: The SEC has proposed new rules to make it easier for investment advisers and regulated funds to hold cryptocurrencies on behalf of clients. The regulatory shift signals growing acceptance of crypto as a mainstream investment asset class.
content: The SEC has proposed new rules that would make it easier for investment advisers and regulated funds to hold cryptocurrencies on behalf of clients.

zh.title: 美国市场监管机构寻求简化基金和顾问持有加密货币的流程
zh.summary: 美国证券交易委员会提出了新规则，使投资顾问和受监管基金更容易代表客户持有加密货币。这一监管转变表明加密货币作为主流投资资产类别的接受度不断提高。

title: Interpol says AI is increasing the speed and scale of cyber threats. Here’s what companies should watch
summary: Interpol warned that AI is accelerating the speed and scale of cyber threats while making them harder to detect, and companies face emerging risks from agentic AI systems. Organizations need to update their security strategies to counter these evolving threats.
content: An Interpol executive warns AI is making existing cyber threats faster and harder to detect, while companies face new risks from the rise of agentic AI.

zh.title: 国际刑警组织表示AI正在加速和扩大网络威胁规模。以下是企业应该关注的内容
zh.summary: 国际刑警组织警告，AI正在加速网络威胁的速度和规模，同时使其更难被检测，企业面临来自代理AI系统的新风险。组织需要更新安全策略来应对这些不断演变的威胁。

title: OpenAI fires workers for mishandling 'sensitive information'
summary: OpenAI fired multiple workers for sharing sensitive data with an external AI evaluation group. The terminations underscore strict data governance policies at major AI companies.
content: The former employees were investigated for sharing data with an outside AI evaluation group.

zh.title: OpenAI因不当处理"敏感信息"而解雇员工
zh.summary: OpenAI因多名员工与外部AI评估小组共享敏感数据而解雇了他们。这些解雇强调了大型AI公司严格的数据治理政策。

title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
summary: A financial advice column addresses whether retirement savings must be split 50/50 when one spouse stayed home to raise children. The question highlights family law complexities in modern financial planning.
content: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”

zh.title: 我的妻子在养育孩子后没有回到工作。我必须50/50分享我的退休储蓄吗？
zh.summary: 一个财务建议专栏讨论了当一个配偶留在家中抚养孩子时，退休储蓄是否必须50/50分割。这个问题突出了现代财务规划中的家庭法复杂性。

title: Here’s who’s joining the S&P 500 in the index’s latest shakeup
summary: Twilio is joining the S&P 500 while Warner Bros Discovery is exiting due to its merger with Paramount. These index changes reflect significant corporate restructuring in the market.
content: Twilio gets the nod, as current component Warner Bros Discovery is due to merger with Paramount.

zh.title: 看谁加入标普500指数最新的调整
zh.summary: Twilio加入标普500指数,而华纳兄弟探索公司因与派拉蒙的合并而退出。这些指数变化反映了市场上重大的企业重组。
